summary:
Before costly qualification, verify that the maintained runner actually invokes the changed assertions and that negative controls fail through that same route; compile success or a zero-test invocation does not establish executable coverage. Assemble compatible source, version, Atlas and delivery-closure changes and reconcile the intended final base before the expensive full run. Defer reporting-only followups when they would invalidate that qualification; this is not a blanket main freeze or permission to bypass required checks. Existing forward recovery retains unavailable original outcomes and reservations as Unknown without repeated unavailable-history searches. Source guidance delivery remains distinct from installed skill adoption and measured process benefit.

The maintained coord-engine workflow implements early executable feedback after build: Core tests and non-vacuity, focused workspace telemetry tests with a five-minute step bound and non-vacuity, then the full mandatory CLI tests and non-vacuity before browser/package/parity qualification. The original forty-minute job bound remains unchanged. Normal TRX and --blame test-sequence artifacts are retained by an always step; no memory dump is enabled. Focused execution is diagnostic evidence, not full qualification or permission to skip the later suite. Earlier opaque failures and later concrete assertion failures retain their own evidence; a repair does not explain an unobserved original or establish timing savings, installed adoption or current runtime acceptance.
title: Verify executable coverage early and assemble compatible changes before costly qualification
